note: Catalog of the SOI published tables the irs-soi `table` endpoint reads. `index` is the page (or pages) that links the files; `file` is a case-insensitive regular expression on a linked file name, its first group the two-digit year. `overrides` adds a year's file where the page links the wrong one. `whole_series`: one file holds every year (read the latest edition).
